assertions.description: BaseAudioContext exposes the readonly renderQuantumSize attribute.
An OfflineAudioContext constructed without a renderSizeHint reports the spec default of 128 frames.
For OfflineAudioContext there is no hardware, so renderSizeHint 'hardware' grants the same quantum as 'default'.
An in-range integer renderSizeHint (512) sets the render quantum size verbatim on an OfflineAudioContext.
A renderSizeHint of 0 is outside the supported range [1, 6 x sampleRate] and must throw NotSupportedError.
A renderSizeHint above 6 x sampleRate (288001 at 48 kHz) must throw NotSupportedError.
A string that is not an AudioContextRenderSizeCategory member ('bogus') is a WebIDL union violation and throws TypeError; a browser that ignores renderSizeHint entirely fails this assertion honestly.
OfflineAudioContext.suspend(t) suspends on a frame that is a multiple of the granted render quantum size and not before t (suspend time rounds up to the quantum boundary).
assertions.test: (async()=>{const sr=48000;const c=new OfflineAudioContext({length:sr,sampleRate:sr,renderSizeHint:512});const q=c.renderQuantumSize;if(typeof q!=='number')return false;const p=c.suspend(0.01).then(()=>{const t=c.currentTime;c.resume().catch(()=>{});return t;});const o=new OscillatorNode(c);o.connect(c.destination);o.start();const[t]=await Promise.all([p,c.startRendering()]);const f=Math.round(t*sr);return f%q===0&&f>=480;})()
